### Close both P1 epics, settle the merge-strategy and GONE questions  ·  P1  ·  0 of 11 done
Follow-on session after the 2026-07-30 bug sweep cleared every defect in the tracker. Two P1 epics are each blocked on a single open leaf, so each closes for the price of one item; this plan does those first. It then records two design decisions that were left open on purpose: that no custom merge driver will be built, because hosted merges run no driver and an unconfigured one silently falls back to something worse, and that clearing a dead ticket link stays a human action, because the signal that reports a ticket missing cannot separate a deleted ticket from one the user lacks permission to read. The code that ships alongside those records is small and closes the exposure that actually exists: the merge guard built earlier runs only on developer machines today, and a project-level lookup failure would currently mark every linked item as missing in a single run.

### IA & content model (supersedes wiki-information-architecture)  ·  P1  ·  8 of 9 done
Reorganize the project wiki so anyone — a new developer, a PM, an auditor — can find the right page and know whether it is current or historical.
